# Al-Safwa Tours & Travels — Vapi, Gujarat (396191)

> Ministry-approved pilgrimage travel operator specializing in bespoke Hajj, Umrah, and Ziyarat packages from Vapi, Valsad district, and South Gujarat.

## Local Geo Coverage (South Gujarat)
- Primary service area: Vapi (396191), Valsad, Daman, Silvassa (Dadra & Nagar Haveli), Pardi, Umbergaon, Bhilad, Sarigam, Navsari, and Surat.
- Airport departure logistics: Direct road transfers from Vapi to Mumbai International Airport (BOM, 160 km) and Surat Airport (STV, 115 km) with dedicated pilgrim coordination.

## Core Services & Packages (2026 Season)
1. **Umrah Packages**:
   - 15 Days Classic Umrah: Verified 3/4-star hotels within 450m of Haram boundaries, direct flights, full visa with medical insurance, 3 Indian/Continental halal meals daily, guided Ziyarat. Starting from ₹85,000 per person.
   - 10 Days Executive VIP Umrah: 5-star courtyard hotels facing Kaaba & Masjid An-Nabawi (zero metres walk), private GMC transfers, tailored family suites. Starting from ₹135,000 per person.
2. **Hajj Packages 2026**:
   - Official Ministry-quota coordination, seasoned God-fearing muallims, air-conditioned VIP Mina & Arafat tents, private Mashair catering, medical assistance, and senior wheelchair care.
3. **Ziyarat Tours**:
   - 8-Day guided Islamic heritage tours covering Cave Hira, Mount Uhud, Masjid Quba, Jannat al-Baqi, and historical Hejaz sites with scholarly Urdu/Gujarati/Hindi/English narrations.
4. **Logistics & Visa Services**:
   - Electronic Saudi Umrah visa processing (5–10 working days).
   - Biometric submission and document verification support in Vapi (396191).
   - Dedicated elderly wheelchair escorts for Tawaf and Sa'i.
